versions.name: Camp Rodman
versions.summary: A small, rustic Buckeye Council camp just outside Alliance, Ohio, with woods and trails suited to single-unit outings, small district activities, and family campouts.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Buckeye Council camp page. The source labeled this a Great Trail Council camp near Barberton, which is incorrect: it is a current Buckeye Council camp near Alliance, owned by the Rodman Foundation and maintained by Buckeye Council. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (the source's coordinates pointed at Barberton); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, correct Buckeye Council operation, and active status verified; source council corrected from Great Trail and location corrected from Barberton to Alliance; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively; features unsurveyed.
